ariaSkip: Skip the architecture map and go to the event table
fitMoreBelowHelp: Scroll down to see the hidden cells
hintEmpty: Select a cell or an edge to filter the table below to its events.
notCollectedHelp: The log source for this range doesn't record it
legendStructural: Structural edge (known only from the order, no count)
legendNotCollected: Not collected (the log source for this range can't fill it)
legendPartial: Partially collected (only some is visible, select the cell for the reason)
legendSelected: The event table is filtered by this cell
legendHighlighted: Where the event picked in the table passed through
legendZone: Zone (a dotted zone is an inner area, such as preparing model input, handling output, and the tool loop)
empty: There are no cells to draw.
layoutNote: Layout preview — counts and collection status aren't shown.
